dialog: I saw my chance to attack/ and I'm taking it!
Nothing personal/ but it's time I finished you off.
You're kind of in the way.
Don't hate me for this.
I'd rather take the safe route/ but if I must...
Okay. Time to press the offensive.
Was all this a miscalculation?
I have to counterattack/ at least.
I'll teach you the price of carelessness.
You're playing with me now.
You're a victim of a reckless maneuver.
Everything's set and ready.
I'm putting a stop to this.
If you're finished/ then it's my turn.
This is the power of a Dowser.
Oh/ these tools aren't for fighting.
Seems like my mice are interested in you.
I'll give you a taste of my abilities.
At least let me get my two koban in.
Whatever it takes/ I'll stop them here.
Underestimate a mouse at your own peril.
I'll show you what a cornered mouse is capable of.
Time for a warm-up.
Gotcha!
Here I go.
Right there!
Looks like we just have to slug this out.
Right there!
Show me the way/ pendulums!
I can do this with my pendulums too.
Time for a long-distance strike!
I'm after things with high rarity.
There we go!
Hey/ it's some koban!
I'll search carefully...
Over here!
Got it!
Time to search...
Found it!
Mgh. That's all?
Time to hunt for some treasure.
Found you!
The more you dig/ the more money comes out...
...though that's only an illusion/ of course.
...though that's only an illusion/ of course.
What's the most valuable treasure around here?
Found it!
Excuse me for a moment.
Huh? It's all pocket change.
Oh/ hey/ now THIS is something.
I can find your weak spots/ too.
I see them!
I'll grind you to pieces...
Huh. Guess I couldn't finish you off.
A token of my sympathy/ if you will.
Bring out the jeweled pagoda/ Master.
Bring out the jeweled pagoda/ Master.
Yes! I believe I put it right in here...
Yes! I believe I put it right in here...\n Umm/ uhh...
Yes! I believe I put it right in here...\n Umm/ uhh... There it is!
Let me borrow it!
Shine/ o jeweled pagoda!
And grant me the greatest of treasures!
Master/ let me borrow the jeweled pagoda.
Master/ let me borrow the jeweled pagoda.
Yes! I believe I put it right in here...
Yes! I believe I put it right in here...\n Umm/ uhh...
Yes! I believe I put it right in here...\n Umm/ uhh... There it is!
Let me borrow it!
Give us your light/ o pagoda!
And bring forth a mountain of treasure!
Master/ let's use the pagoda!
Master/ let's use the pagoda!
Yes! I believe I put it right in here...
Yes! I believe I put it right in here...\n Umm/ uhh...
Yes! I believe I put it right in here...\n Umm/ uhh... There it is!
Let me borrow it!
Show them Bishamonten's authority!
This is quite a view/ isn't it?
You have a rarity of 0. I don't even need to fight you.
It doesn't look like an immediate counterattack is a good idea...
This when I'd rather things NOT take forever...
I'm pretty good at skittering away.
I'm a sitting duck—er/ mouse at this point...
I don't like how one-sided this is...
...If you were trying to make me mad/ it worked.
Let's try a coordinated attack.
Leave this to me. I'll intercept.
I'll take over from here. You can back off.
Whoa. Keep an eye out/ will you?
This won't go how you want it to.
Good decision. I'll help.
This will make it easier for you/ right?
I'll draw their attention!
We're pairing up/ so don't get yourself hurt.
I'll be right behind you. Show me your abilities.
I'll be able to safely fight from here.
We're after that one/ right? Got it.
This is the perfect chance to attack!
I can look for a treasure or two for you.
I can't let this opportunity escape.
Ugh! I can't believe I dragged Daiyousei down!
Good job/ Daiyousei.
I'll keep things going here/ Daiyousei.
Daiyousei/ don't force yourself/ alright?
You're up too far/ Daiyousei!
I can tell you want to fight.
I can't let Daiyousei do all the work.
Daiyousei/ you could just switch with me.
Don't push yourself too hard/ Daiyousei.
I'll be right behind you/ Daiyousei.
Let's focus our attacks/ Daiyousei!
Now's our chance/ Daiyousei!
I can look for a treasure or two for you/ Daiyousei.
Chen! I can't believe she'd protect a mouse like that...
Chen/ you need to follow through more.
I'll keep things going here/ Chen.
A mouse protecting a cat... Imagine that.
You're out too far/ Chen!
We're both quick on our feet—let's use that to our advantage.
We'll go in for a distraction/ Chen.
I can't let Chen do all the work.
It's alright—I'm not the one chasing you.
Aim carefully/ Chen!
I'll be right there with you/ Chen!
We're both quick on our feet—let's use that to our advantage.
Let's focus our attacks/ Chen!
Now's our chance/ Chen!
I can look for a treasure or two for you/ Chen.
I'm sorry about this/ both of you...
I'll keep things going here/ Ichirin.
Ichirin/ leave the rest to me.
You're out too far/ Ichirin!
Watch out/ Ichirin!
Say hello to Unzan for me/ Ichirin!
Leave the distractions to me/ Ichirin!
Is Unzan all set/ Ichirin?
It's your time to shine/ Ichirin!
Let's go after that one/ Ichirin.
Don't get too violent and catch me in it/ alright?
Don't do TOO well now/ Ichirin.
Now's our chance/ Ichirin!
I can look for a treasure or two for you/ Ichirin.
Skipper/ you're straining yourself too much!
I'll keep things going here/ Skipper.
Leave the rest to me/ Skipper.
You're out too far/ Skipper!
Watch out/ Skipper!
Skipper/ I want to go treasure hunting.
Leave the distractions to me/ Skipper!
I'll follow your orders/ Skipper.
It's your time to shine/ Skipper!
Let's go after that one/ Skipper.
Now's our chance/ Skipper!
I'll flee the sinking ship if I have to/ Skipper!
I can look for a treasure or two for you/ Skipper.
You did it to yourself/ Master...
I'll follow up/ Master!
Your skills haven't dulled/ have they/ Master?
Let's swap. You did well.
Leave the rest to me/ Master.
Stay alert/ Master!
You're out too far/ Master!
I'll fight from the rear. You do your best/ Master.
This should make it easier for Master.
Master can handle this.
Let's go after that one/ Master.
I abide by my master's decisions.
I can look for a treasure or two for you/ Master.
Now's our chance/ Master!
I'll be watching/ Master!
No! Everyone's ship/ it's...
This is Nazrin. Moving to intercept.
Let's link up. Just don't hit me/ alright?
You did a good job/ Skipper.
It's a big boat/ you know? Of course I'll back it up.
Getting a little slow/ Skipper?
No! Everyone's ship/ it's...
This is Nazrin. Moving to intercept.
That's a pretty good position/ Acting Captain.
This won't go the way you want it to.
It takes some getting used to. I'll back you up.
Detecting danger is one of my many talents.
There was a safe spot in your danmaku.
I'm doing things the smart and safe way.
A piece of advice: don't look down on mice.
That's it? What a disappointment.
What a boring attack.
Even I can probably beat this one.
Even I can handle an attack like that!
Looks like this is going to be a tough fight.
I'm really letting them have the run of things here...
...I've had enough of this game of cat-and-mouse.
A fine performance...
Urgh! But you're not taking me down that easily.
Trapped like a rat...
This was more than I predicted...
That was careless of me...
I couldn't predict how they'd move?!
I thought I had my guard up...
My mice... Okay/ I think they're fine.
Come on/ pendulums! Don't give out on me yet!
I'll just have to endure it for now.
My pendulums are just as durable as they look.
Oww. Why do you have to be so violent?
I'm telling you/ I'm just a weak little mouse.
That came pretty close to me...
Great. I managed to shake them off.
Hey/ you missed!
What/ is that all you had?
C'mon! I'm over here!
It's important to change tactics as the situation demands.
Dodging isn't everything.
You'll want to mind the sound of my mice.
Alright. I'll try getting through it like this.
I'm a pro at wriggling into tiny spaces.
I'm not a fan of gambling.
You need to clean up your attacks a little or you'll never hit me!
I'm a clever mouse/ you see.
You were so close. Too bad!
It's a good thing that one didn't hit me.
Heh heh heh. What are you/ some sort of fool?
You won't reach me with that.
Here's an effective use of my pendulums!
It just means you're that easy to read.
This shouldn't damage the rods... I think...
If you want to be careless and get close to me/ be my guest.
My mice told me you'd be coming from that direction.
I knew I wasn't cut out for fighting.
I misjudged how strong they were...
It's too dangerous to stay here. I'm taking the safe approach and withdrawing.
My apologies/ but I can't go any longer. Be sure to keep your eyes open.
Didn't think a mouse could put up a fight/ did you?
Even a mouse will bite a cat/ you know.
My natural enemy? I don't like these odds...
Ack. I can't match her strength...
You're too focused on what's right in front of you.
Bakeneko just aren't what they used to be/ huh?
Go easy on me just this once/ please?
Fighting someone I know is better than me really doesn't seem like a good idea...
Do I even have a chance of winning?
I knew she was strong/ but not this strong...
Always lead the strong ones on a chase. That's how you handle them.
It's a good thing that one didn't hit me.
I've come this far. Just have to do what I can.
I'd like a more reliable way to fight/ but I guess that's asking for too much.
I'm still standing after that? That's a win in my book.
Agh. I can't take another one of those...
I've been spotted? Things just got a lot more dangerous.
I'm not dying here. I swear it.
The Youkai Sage? I want to see how strong she is.
Can't let that take me down. I'll at least resist a little.
Do I have any option to run? No/ it's too late for that.
The sheer strength... She's a beast.
I'm not dying here. I swear it.
Always lead the strong ones on a chase. That's how you handle them.
Oh boy/ here we go. Sure/ I'll play along.
Looks like you've got a little too much energy on your hands...
You're better than I expected...
I'd kind of like to avoid a loss here...
It's too dangerous to fight/ but... I don't have much of a choice.
I'm worried about the ship/ but we have to calm Yatagarasu's power as fast as we can...
Oh boy/ here we go. Sure/ I'll play along.
Looks like you've got a little too much energy on your hands...
So you're the leader today/ huh?
Lightning? I've gotta watch myself.
My mice are instinctively trying to flee...
She's got a screw loose/ but she's nothing if not a powerhouse.
You came out of THERE?
She doesn't seem all that strong/ but...
Nue/ stop all this!
You came out of THERE?
The scope of her power is just... Very fitting for the one behind it all.
If you ask me/ I'd rather just hide somewhere until it's over.
None of them would lose to illusions like these.
I don't think we need you to show us the way anymore.
If you're just stalling for time/ then I'll get you out of the way.
So/ you've chosen violence...
You're going to wear yourself out at this rate.
If you can't fight/ then you need to withdraw.
I'm not going to slip up this time!
Your power is far-reaching/ but...
It's time for our radiance to put an end to you!
